budget_items.what_was_said: The station manager reported a shortfall in the salaries line item for the remainder of the fiscal year and covered it through line-item transfers.

budget_items.topic: FY26 line-item transfers to cover salary shortfall
budget_items.what_was_said: The manager moved money out of the new equipment, advertisement, and equipment maintenance and supplies lines to make up the shortfall.
A loaner network switch solved audio problems in the control room and the committee will need to buy a replacement of its own.
The manager reviewed the current fund balance including the last Comcast fee payment, noting it had not yet been posted when the packet was prepared.
The manager projected salaries through April, May and June against the amount budgeted for the year, coming in over budget.
The manager projected this line would come in under budget by year end.

budget_items.topic: FY27 proposed budget: salaries and payroll videographers
budget_items.what_was_said: The submitted FY27 budget lists salaries and payroll videographers, plus a one-time longevity payment to the manager.
Salaries and longevity pay together were totaled on the budget sheet.
The line was increased to fund renting studio space in the new fiscal year at roughly a set amount per month.
This line pays the bulletin administrator consultant, described as about five hours of his time, kept to leave the line open.
The line was reduced because the committee has no studio and does not expect much activity on the account.

budget_items.topic: Legal fees for cable advisory committee
budget_items.what_was_said: A loose quote for legal counsel to start the cable advisory committee was split across two budget years.

budget_items.topic: Indirect costs (salaries, Medicare, health insurance, workers comp, retirement, life insurance)
budget_items.what_was_said: Finance calculated the indirect cost figure for staff and videographers, and the committee questioned how it compared to the prior year and to an expected health insurance increase.

budget_items.topic: FY27 total operating and salary expense
budget_items.what_was_said: The manager totaled operation expenses with the salaries figure to reach a combined expense total.

budget_items.topic: FY27 user charges (Comcast franchise fee) revenue estimate
budget_items.what_was_said: Revenue was estimated based on a quarterly Comcast payment.
Investment income was estimated lower than before, combining a bank CD and town account interest, described as less than half the prior estimate.
User charges and investment income together were totaled as the year's PEG revenue.

budget_items.topic: FY27 PEG budget shortfall / retained earnings transfer
budget_items.what_was_said: The gap between revenue and expenses will be covered by a transfer from retained earnings, separate from the Castis capital request.

budget_items.topic: FY2027 warrant article: PEG operating budget appropriation
budget_items.what_was_said: The draft warrant article appropriates PEG revenue and transfers retained earnings for a combined FY2027 PEG operating budget total.
A separate warrant article seeks a retained-earnings transfer to replace the Castis broadcast software and server, at end of life, ahead of expected vendor tariff price increases.
The quoted Castis unit itself was the first line item on the vendor's quote.

budget_items.topic: Castis quote: annual support and maintenance
budget_items.what_was_said: A one-year support and maintenance package including training hours recurs as a yearly fee.
An optional annual subscription would let viewers watch the channel on a mobile app; the manager questioned whether the recurring cost was worth it.
A one-time cost was quoted to migrate content from the retiring server to the new Castis system.

budget_items.topic: Castis quote: professional services, installation and training
budget_items.what_was_said: Installation, materials, hardware, travel and mileage for vendor training of staff were quoted together.

budget_items.topic: Supplies line item impact of Castis package
budget_items.what_was_said: The manager warned that buying the full Castis package would consume most of the supplies line, leaving little for the music license and other regular purchases.

budget_items.topic: Reconciling the total Castis quote figure
budget_items.what_was_said: Committee members tried to reconcile a total quote figure against the manager's own estimate and could not agree whether the first-year subscription was already included, calling the discrepancy significant.

decisions.decision: Agreed that if the Castis system isn't fully installed by June 30, that is fine because it is budgeted and committed in FY26.
Agreed to leave the upgraded motherboard line item in the Castis quote rather than remove it.
Agreed to include optional add-ons (mobile app, branded streaming channel) now and re-evaluate usage in a year, since removing features later is easier than adding them.
Manager will confirm outstanding quote questions with the vendor and email all committee members the answers, asking that replies go to her individually rather than reply-all.
Tabled the PACC policy vote item because a required member was absent.
Enterprise fund investment status will be reported at the next meeting once the town's figures are available.

minutes.headline: PACC will ask town meeting to tap retained earnings to close a budget gap and replace its aging broadcast system.
not_audible: The transfer amount from the new equipment line ('$ 36.50') around 278s is likely a mis-transcribed larger figure.
The indirect cost figure is given as both roughly $20,972 and 2972 in the same exchange (1150-1235s); which is correct is unclear.
The FY27 total operating/salary expense figures around 1403-1425s ('67 172', '150', '21784. 47') are fragmented and could not be reconciled into one confident total.
Whether the reconciled Castis quote total (heard as both 62,000 and 63,200) includes the first-year subscription fee was left unresolved by the committee.
Cross-talk about office space and equipment ownership around 1000-1060s is hard to attribute to individual speakers.
The name heard as 'Steve Ash Clark' (absent member) and 'Joe Lee' near the end are likely mis-hearings; exact names are uncertain.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee reviewed the manager's report, a FY26 salary shortfall covered by line-item transfers, and the FY27 budget, then spent most of the meeting going through a vendor quote to replace its aging Castis broadcast system. No formal budget or purchase vote was taken; both the FY27 PEG operating budget shortfall and the Castis system replacement will go to town meeting as warrant articles funded partly from retained earnings. A pending PACC policy vote was tabled because a member was absent.

what_happened.line: Both the FY27 public-access budget shortfall and an aging broadcast-system replacement will go to town meeting as warrant articles, partly funded from retained earnings, without a committee vote.
A shortfall in this year's salary line was covered by shifting money out of the equipment, advertising, and maintenance lines rather than a new appropriation.
The committee decided to keep optional add-ons, including a mobile app and a branded streaming channel, in the broadcast-system quote for now and reassess after a year.
A vote on committee policy was tabled because a required member was absent.
A discrepancy in the health-insurance cost estimate for next year's budget was left unresolved, with the manager assigned to follow up.

why_it_matters: Town meeting will be asked to approve warrant articles drawing on the cable fund's retained earnings for both an operating shortfall and new equipment.
Covering this year's salary line by moving money out of equipment and advertising shows the budget already running tight before the fiscal year closes.
A new ADA-mandated audio description requirement and an unsettled health-insurance figure could add to what the FY27 budget needs to cover.

Next PACC meeting: the tabled policy vote and the enterprise fund investment status report

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.coverage: official minutes are a summary only
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the studio lease, the investment drop, the legal fees and the Comcast balance. The official minutes are a short summary with no votes besides minutes approval and adjournment, and none of the FY27 budget, warrant article or transfer figures. The main differences to check are the Castis quote (monthly vs annual maintenance, and whether $34,895 is the total or only the base unit) and the tabled policy vote that the official minutes don't mention.
